subtitle: Introduction to Robotics
keywords: Engineering and regional collaboration 2.Robotics 3.Robot components and design technology 4.Measurement, control, information technology 5.System integration technology
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn essentials of robotics engineering. (2) Learn the relationships among the fields of the future society and industries. (3) Set goals for own career design as robotic engineers as students of the department of robotics.
advice: Consider and explain the future development of robotics field and describe your career plans and future goals. Students are required to actively participate in classes.
requiredKnowledge: It is important that students not only learn from the textbook and the practice of this course but also understand the role of robotics and identify fields of robotics engineers.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
